title: The authority total-deadline test's expired control accepts any publication error, not specifically the Deadline
outcome: source_root_authority_review_one_total_deadline_covers_prepare_read_and_publish (src/tests/engram_root_authority.rs) asserts that the expired control fails with the Deadline classification, as the sibling prepared-ack expiry test does with error.message.contains("(Deadline)"), so an unrelated publication failure cannot satisfy it. Optionally, the Candidate-fence guard asserts the pending count separately, so its panic names the right condition.
acceptance: The expired control asserts the Deadline classification of the publication error, and a publication failure for another reason fails the test.
The test passes on the unchanged product code.
